title: Young Frankenstein
tagline: Back at the family castle. Goulash on.
about: The grandson of Dr Frankenstein returns to the family castle and can't resist the experiment.
cue: Serve the goulash when Igor answers "What hump?" at the station.
faces: Ration sheet. Results may vary. Seconds encouraged.
Cheddar, gouda and Swiss on a dark board with rye crispbread.
Swirled beetroot hummus with tahini, lemon and garlic, with crackers.
Slow beef goulash with paprika and caraway, on buttered noodles with sour cream.
The hermit pours hot soup into the monster's lap.
Chocolate cupcakes in tall buttercream top hats.
Hot milk whisked with honey, vanilla and cinnamon until frothy.
Wait, the hermit was gonna make espresso.
Form LAB74, rev. 1974. Return tray to the hatch. Rations subject to supply.

    StartersCastle cheese and crackersCheddar, gouda and Swiss on a dark board with rye crispbread.How to make it120g vintage cheddar120g gouda120g Swiss cheese1 pack rye crispbread1 jar pickled onions1 pot grainy mustardCut the vintage cheddar, gouda and Swiss cheese into rough chunks on a dark wooden board.Add the crispbread, pickled onions and mustard.Leave out so the cheese softens before serving.Abby Normal's brain dipSwirled beetroot hummus with tahini, lemon and garlic, with crackers.How to make it2 beetroots400g chickpeas, drained3 tbsp tahini1 lemon, juiced1 garlic clove3 tbsp water150g crackersWrap the beetroots in foil and roast at 200°C.Peel the beetroots.Blitz with the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic and water until smooth.Swirl into a bowl and serve with crackers.MainsTransylvanian goulashSlow beef goulash with paprika and caraway, on buttered noodles with sour cream.How to make it1kg beef chuck, diced3 brown onions, sliced2 tbsp sweet paprika1 tsp caraway seeds400g crushed tomatoes300ml beef stock400g egg noodles20g butter150g sour cream2 tbsp vegetable oilBrown the beef in batches in oil.Cook the onions slowly.Stir in the paprika and caraway, then add the tomatoes, stock and beef.Cover and braise at 160°C.Boil the noodles and toss with butter.Serve over the noodles with sour cream.The blind hermit's chicken soupThe hermit pours hot soup into the monster's lapHow to make itAs written, serves 4A big pot of chicken and vegetable soup with shredded thigh meat, egg noodles, dill and lemon, ladled out hot with crusty bread.Simmer 800g chicken thighs in 2L chicken stock with 1 onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks, diced, and 2 bay leaves for 45 minutes.Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot.Add 150g egg noodles and cook 6 minutes.Season with salt, pepper and the juice of half a lemon, and stir in chopped dill.Serve hot with crusty bread.SweetsPuttin' on the Ritz cupcakesChocolate cupcakes in tall buttercream top hats.How to make it275g butter150g caster sugar2 eggs170g self-raising flour60g cocoa100ml full cream milk250g icing sugar100g white chocolateBeat about half the butter with the sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour, half the cocoa and the milk.Bake in 12 cases at 175°C.Cool.Melt the white chocolate into 12 thin discs and set.Beat the remaining butter, icing sugar and cocoa.Pipe a tall swirl on each and sit a disc under each as a hat brim.DrinksFrau Blücher's brandy milk punchHot milk whisked with honey, vanilla and cinnamon until frothy, spiked with brandy and dusted with nutmeg, the two offers in one mug.How to make it800ml full cream milk3 tbsp honey1 cinnamon stick1/2 tsp vanilla extract120ml brandy1/4 tsp nutmeg, freshly gratedWarm the milk with the honey, cinnamon and vanilla until steaming without boiling.Rest and remove the cinnamon.Whisk hard until frothy.Pour into mugs, add brandy to each and grate over a little nutmeg.
